stories.title: Georgia new No. 1 in AP poll; Texas falls to 7, Ducks go unranked
stories.summary: Georgia moved to the No. 1 spot in the Week 7 AP Top 25 following its win at Alabama while Oregon was unranked for the first time in four years after falling to 3-2.

stories.title: Browns WR Concepcion knocked out of game vs. Jets after illegal hit
stories.summary: Browns rookie wide receiver KC Concepcion sustained a head injury in the first quarter of the team's game against the Jets and was ruled out.

stories.title: Vikings TE Hockenson suffers concussion on 2nd play of game
stories.summary: The Vikings' injury-ravaged offense absorbed another blow when tight end T.J. Hockenson suffered a concussion on the second play of their game against the Saints.

stories.title: Florida flips Texas commit Royal, top WR in class of 2027
stories.summary: Five-star wide receiver prospect Easton Royal has flipped his commitment to Florida, his family told ESPN on Sunday. The New Orleans native is the top-ranked wide receiver and No. 8 overall prospect in the SC Next ESPN 300.

stories.title: Eagles, already depleted at RB, lose Shipley to foot injury
stories.summary: Eagles running back Will Shipley was ruled out of Sunday's game against the Jaguars with a foot injury.
